title: Canonical blow-ups of Lagrangian and Orthogonal Grassmannians
summary: Let $\mathbf{LG}(V\oplus V^*)$ and $\mathbf{OG}^+(V\oplus V^*)$ denote the Lagrangian and orthogonal Grassmannians endowed with the natural $\mathbb{G}_m$-actions, respectively. Thaddeus proved that over $\mathbb{C}$, the Hilbert quotients $\mathbf{LG}(V\oplus V^*)\!/\!/\mathbb{G}_m$ and $\mathbf{OG}^+(V\oplus V^*)\!/\!/\mathbb{G}_m$ are isomorphic to the wonderful compactifications of the spaces of symmetric and skew-symmetric matrices of maximal ranks, that is, the spaces of complete quadrics and complete skew-forms, respectively.
